state_dimensions.source_of_truth: Per-role durable progress != scene admission != client observation != Quest15 available != reward ledger

persistence.transaction_rule: Current full SessionLease, selected role, SQLite ban and phase-specific CAS must guard any authoritative state change, no cross-transaction check-then-act
persistence.replay_rule: Unique per role/lease epoch/admission/request/event payload fingerprints; old session cannot claim replay success
persistence.transport_rule: Internal durable event at-most-once effect; outbox at-least-once delivery with consumer dedup, not exactly-once TCP
persistence.provider_scope: SQLite local C02-D ban exists; PostgreSQL identical moderation is not independently confirmed

packages.title: Per-role tutorial completion eligibility and durable checkpoint
invariants: Only approved product policy may combine persisted ScenarioTerminal, Quest14/16 turn-in, RewardLedger finality and relevant quest progress into completion eligibility; Quest15 AVAILABLE alone is insufficient
Persist per-CharacterId TutorialProgress with immutable policy/config digest and monotone revision, separate AccountId, SessionLease, EncounterId and Client local flags
Do not conflate business COMPLETED checkpoint with SceneExitApproved or Client WorldReady; product-specific completion-vs-exit ordering requires explicit maintainer review
Every mutation rechecks full current SessionLease, owned selected CharacterId and SQLite moderation within same transaction/fenced authority; stale epoch and changed request fingerprint reject
Idempotent completion checkpoint has a unique event id and audit; no duplicate Quest/Reward mutation or invented native tutorial-complete field
packages.native_blocker: T15/T16/T04 original tutorial completion writer, account-vs-character granularity and authorized terminal/exit ordering unknown

packages.title: Exit admission, pending transfer and scene lease fencing
invariants: Scene exit is a separate versioned admission ID with current account/role/session lease and authorized mock destination policy, never inferred from Quest15 static SceneList or LoadMap town001D
Use admission RESERVED->TRANSFERRING->WORLD_DOMAIN_ADMITTED or ABORTED/EXPIRED with unique scoped request/epoch, actor/scene leases and CAS; no two live exit admissions per role
Do not destroy or duplicate prior tutorial encounter/role progress until transfer has a durable committed handoff and approved cleanup/rollback policy
Disconnect, ban, renewal, concurrent login or stale scene lease fences old transfer writes; retries return same durable result only after reauthorization
Mock world admission is only an internal Server domain fact; original KR scene/Conn/field/actor bootstrap writer and native adapter remain disabled
packages.native_blocker: T07/T05/T06/T16 original scene leave, 0x005F type6 ambiguity, world bootstrap and positive field admission unknown

packages.title: World-ready gates and Client observation separation
invariants: Track three distinct dimensions: authorized Server world admission, installed scene/actor snapshot in mock environment, and observed Client scene/control readiness; no dimension implies another
For original Client, SceneLoaded/ControlReady require same-build positive runtime evidence and separate authorization; synthetic mock observation must be visibly labeled MOCK_ONLY
Do not infer WorldReady from C2S0x42, S2C0x69, C2S0x43, scene+0xCC pending, Lua LoadMap, Quest15 AVAILABLE or Server API success
No invented official town/field IDs, spawn coordinates, ready ACK/opcode or retry policy; dummy mock scene key remains opaque and source-gated
Without original native adapter, expose only internal mock readiness state and keep protocol writer OFF; no public game listener feature is switched on
packages.native_blocker: Original KR Client correct field/actor/control-ready sequence, direction-specific frames and runtime observation not demonstrated

packages.title: Relog/crash/ban recovery and durable transition reconciliation
invariants: After restart or new lease restore per-role progress/quest ledger/settlement/scene admission consistently, never restore stale SessionLease or assume original Client controls are ready

Crash points before checkpoint commit, after checkpoint before transfer, after transfer before outbox and after delivery before ACK must reconcile without re-awarding, re-spawning or regressing terminal state
New login/renew/revoke/ban/unban fences prior epoch including pending Client observations; unban never revives revoked login or Scene admission
If no approved destination/bootstrap or failure/recovery policy, return explicit BLOCKED/PENDING and preserve durable state rather than looping tutorial or marking WorldReady
SQLite v2 and PostgreSQL migration003 require a single centrally sequenced C05 migration plan; use offline backup/restore-new with data integrity and uniqueness tests before any production approval
